description: National Physical Planning Department - Declare that the Area of Dambadeniya Sri Wijaya Sundararama Rajamaha Viharaya as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of a religious site ("Dambadeniya Sri Wijayasundararama Rajamaha Viharaya") as an urban development area under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. The document contains detailed land descriptions, survey information, boundary demarcations, and coordinates, which are characteristic of Land Gazettes (Type 4). While a minister is named, this is not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, but rather about the exercise of statutory powers related to land development and planning.
